title: The 'alpha male' is a lie. The man who made it famous said so 🐺
caption:
Wolves don't fight to be alpha. They're just a family 🐺❤️
Tag a self-proclaimed alpha 👇
first_comment: Did you believe the alpha myth? 🐺👇
sources: Mech L. D. (1999) 'Alpha status, dominance, and division of labor in wolf packs', Canadian Journal of Zoology 77: 1196-1203
Schenkel R. (1947) captive wolf studies (Basel Zoo) as the origin of the alpha concept
